# Ridgeline Roofing

A four-person roofing firm in Whitby, North Yorkshire, working on pitched slate and
clay tile roofs. The site is four public pages and carries no catalogue, no booking
system and no logins.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://example.com/): what the firm does and where it works.
- [What roof work costs](https://example.com/pricing): how a job is quoted and which
  three factors move the figure most.
- [Choosing roof tiles for a coastal roof](https://example.com/guides/roof-tile-selection):
  clay, concrete and slate compared for exposure within two miles of the sea.
- [Contact](https://example.com/contact): phone, email, yard address and survey radius.

## Notes

Prices are never published as figures on the site; every quote follows a written
survey. Anything stated here about cost is a description of the method, not a rate.
